result.title: COMET: A coordinated multi-layer runtime monitoring framework for human-supervised AI-enabled safety systems
result.comment: for associated GitHub repository, see https://github.com/nicmig/COMET
result.summary: Incorporating AI systems into safety systems requires monitoring to avoid silent faults and ensure safe and reliable operation. Single monitors often do not provide actionable information for human supervisors, who act as the system's adaptive controller. We present COMET, a coordinated multi-layer runtime monitoring framework for human-supervised AI-enabled safety systems in which each monitor is anchored in a different fault mode. Monitor outputs are combined in a coordination layer and mapped by a communication layer to a traffic-light display. In this work, COMET consists of three monitoring layers: signal integrity, physics consistency, and the AI system's competence envelope. The framework is evaluated on an open dataset of compressed-air leaks, where an AI system detects leaks from acoustic emissions, with held-out conditions simulating covariate shift, semantic shift, and sensor faults, events expected during runtime but unknown in their exact appearance. All monitors are frozen after development and tested zero-shot, and the framework is compared against no-monitoring and single-monitor setups. The bare AI system fails silently and confidently under all three shift types, whereas COMET reduces the trusted-wrong-answer rate to zero on covariate-shifted no-leak data and on three of four sensor faults, at a nominal false-alarm rate of $\approx 1\%$. Single monitors come close in detection but cannot attribute the fault mode. COMET converts their anonymous detection flags into diagnoses. Residual silent misses under semantic shift define the boundary of passive monitoring. Runtime monitoring frameworks for AI-enabled safety systems must therefore combine quantitative fault detection and isolation with qualitative, human-oriented feedback.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 COMET——面向人监督 AI 安全系统的协调式多层运行时监测框架，将信号完整性、物理一致性与 AI「能力包络」三层监测结果经协调层与通信层汇总为交通灯式提示；在压缩空气泄漏声学检测数据上，于协变量偏移、语义偏移和传感器故障的留出条件下零样本评测，显著降低「自信错答」率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「能力包络＋多源监测信号协调→可行动故障归因」思路，可能为 LVR 中何时停止/重看、以及 latent 状态可信度的分层校验提供概念线索，但属工业安全监测，迁移可行性需较多核查。
